reviews.text:
Arcaplanet's prices have gone up, but the people working there are incredibly kind and attentive, so it's a pleasure to return... except when that cashier follows you through the aisles to guard the ham bones. Display them higher up if you don't want the dogs to sniff them!
If you buy on the app and pick up in-store, the prices are always lower than buying directly in-store.
The girl with the wine-red hair and glasses is very good and kind!
Thank you, Eloi Cardoso dos Santos. We're delighted to hear your positive feedback about Arcaplanet! Thank you so much for your trust.
Good products, at all prices and affordable, good service.

Excellent store, well-managed and well-stocked. The staff are kind and professional, and I've been coming here for years. It's always a pleasure to stop by. Giorgia, Luca, and Valentina have often given me valuable advice. Thank you!
Hi Alessandro Boschian Pest, we're sorry to hear about your review. We're here to help you understand the reasons.
Truly unsurpassed in every sense

I was stocking up on food for my cat, choosing random items (because there's too much variety and it's confusing) when the sales assistant Marica came over to help me and recommend better, natural, and healthy products. I was pleasantly surprised by her attention to detail and thoroughness in explaining what's in the food that best suits my cat's healthy diet. Thank you so much, Marica.

They're nice and kind, but 8 times out of 10 the store is understocked, with carts full of boxes sitting in front of the dog treats, and many items are missing from the shelves.
This happens every day for the entire opening hours.
The store management and the organization of the store are in dire straits. How can you sell if the shelves are empty?
Nice clerks.
Very large store with typical chain dimensions. Friendly staff, and parking is possible depending on the occupancy of the nearby supermarket.
A special thanks to the very kind Valentina for her patience and for the excellent advice she gave me, thank you so much!
Thank you, Giovanni Borro, your little stars made us shine! Come back and visit us.

Well, what can I say? I didn't find what I was looking for, but the store manager is knowledgeable, helpful, and... friendly.
We'll be back 😉 My puppy Lucio and I. …
The staff is always friendly and helpful. The products are good and there's a wide selection to choose from.
One star because less is the best. The staff is incompetent and uninterested. The store is often messy and poorly stocked.

Very friendly staff. Whenever I stop by to pick up kibble or have questions, they always know how to answer and help me. The store is small but well-stocked.
Highly recommended.

The staff is very attentive and courteous, despite their young age. They're all young and courteous, and you'd be hard-pressed to find them elsewhere. They recommended some of their products to me, and I have to say I was really happy with them. Definitely an excellent store.
very rude staff, always out of supplies and they almost never answer the phone

Very knowledgeable and friendly staff.
Prices are reasonable, but there are plenty of offers and online shopping options.

Excellent selection and quality. The staff is friendly and courteous.
Recommended
Went on Sunday I asked for a favor after buying a product very rude employee
Excellent
Very kind and helpful, tidy....
The manager was super helpful with product selection! Excellent experience.
Congratulations, the seller is very kind and fast
They have little choice in collars but ok
Excellent friendly and helpful staff

I didn't find what I was looking for, but what I didn't like was that two employees were waiting on just one person. I wanted to ask a question to find out what I was looking for, but they wouldn't even look at me until I stood in front of them. One of them, spitefully, told me to wait a moment while he finished chatting with his colleague and the only customer they were both waiting for. Finally, I asked about the product I was looking for, and he immediately said, "This store doesn't carry that product." At least be a little kind when answering. We're all customers. I can't believe Arcaplanet doesn't have any reptile products. I'll never set foot in that store again.

The shop is very well stocked, but what really sets it apart from other shops is the staff. Daniela, Matteo, and Luca are incredibly knowledgeable, kind, and friendly. My dogs love them, and so do we. 😍 Thank you! HIGHLY RECOMMENDED! …
Very good and patient!!!

Trusted Arcaplanet store.
Always available and ready to solve any problem.
Highly recommended!
Wide selection, helpful and unobtrusive staff. With the card, you'll always find great deals.
Very courteous and knowledgeable sales assistants.
